doc: A plan's target date (timeline and budget hub plan H3): work/target/set writes data.target_at, null clears it, a task id is refused and an id with no live entity answers false.

sql: insert into entity (n, id, kind, title, data, origin, ver, created_tx, updated_tx) values (900, 'plan:p1', 'plan', 'A plan', '{}', 'recorded', 1, 1, 1)
select cast(json_extract(data, '$.target_at') as integer) from entity where id = 'plan:p1'
select json_extract(data, '$.target_at') is null from entity where id = 'plan:p1'
